title: H5 repair: the learned net2 v7, unchanged, on net1 v7 retrained with capacity less constant-rate UDP
description: net1's cost to the learned net2 traces to its capacity belief, too high when the flow is alone, a hedge against constant-rate UDP that a flow cannot tell from a slower link (runs 283, 286). exp-net1-v7-less-udp-290 retrained net1 v7 with its scalers and bins kept, on the capacity label as before (net1 c, the control for retraining) and on the capacity less the constant-rate UDP traffic (net1 u, the repair). Each learned DAgger net2 on net1 v7 (round 29, iteration 39, training seeds 1 to 3; model-truth-patch-src) runs unchanged on net1 v7 (net2-v7-sN), on net1 c (net2-v7-c-sN) and on net1 u (net2-v7-u-sN; experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py --net1), beside the fixed rule at u = 0.25 on each (rule-v7, rule-c, rule-u). Validation links at campaign seed 21 (the five families) and 2 and 4 copies. Criterion, stated before the run: the repair holds (H5) if net2 on net1 u beats net2 on net1 c by at least 0.01 on the five-family mean over the three training seeds, with no family worse by more than 0.02. Nothing is chosen.
prepare: (cd "$IN/t" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); declare -A N=([v7]="$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" [c]="$IN/r/net1-v7-capacity/net1.pt" [u]="$IN/r/net1-v7-less_udp/net1.pt"); P=(); for k in v7 c u; do uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/rule-$k" "${N[$k]}" --u 0.25; P+=(--policy "rule-$k=$OUT/rule-$k/rule-u0.25.onnx"); done; for s in s1 s2 s3; do d="$OUT/runs/r29-$s"; mkdir -p "$d"; cp "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" "$d/net1.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-$s.actor.pt" "$d/actor.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-$s.ppo_spec.json" "$d/ppo_spec.json"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7-$s" "$d" --t 0.5; P+=(--policy "net2-v7-$s=$OUT/p/net2-v7-$s.onnx"); for k in c u; do uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7-$k-$s" "$d" --t 0.5 --net1 "${N[$k]}"; P+=(--policy "net2-v7-$k-$s=$OUT/p/net2-v7-$k-$s.onnx"); done; done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 24 ]; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s && for s in s1 s2 s3; do uv run python experiments/versus_rule.py "$OUT" "net2-v7-c-$s"; done && uv run python experiments/versus_rule.py "$OUT" rule-c
